title: MT-RGCN-DTI: A Multi-Task Relational Graph Convolutional Network for Drug-Target Interaction Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.20109v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Prediction of drug-target interaction (DTI) has become a very crucial part of drug discovery. With the increase in the data volume, it has become very important to improve prediction accuracy by integrating multiple data sources. In this regard, utilising multiple resources in the form of heterogeneous information network to address DTI prediction can be rewarding. In this work, we propose a heterogeneous information network based multi-task DTI prediction model which leverages the advantages of relation graph convolutional network (RGCN). To achieve this, the model employs drug-target interaction network, drug-drug similarity network and protein-protein similarity network to construct a heterogeneous information network. Moreover, we use a knowledge graph embedding scoring functions to model interactions between drug and targets, specifically DistMult and ComplEx as decoders over the learned node representations. translated_abstract: 药物-靶点相互作用（DTI）预测已成为药物发现中至关重要的组成部分。随着数据量的不断增长，通过整合多种数据源来提高预测准确性变得非常重要。在这方面，以异构信息网络的形式利用多种资源来解决DTI预测问题可能带来显著收益。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于异构信息网络的多任务DTI预测模型，该模型充分发挥了关系图卷积网络（RGCN）的优势。为实现这一目标，该模型利用药物-靶点相互作用网络、药物-药物相似性网络和蛋白质-蛋白质相似性网络来构建异构信息网络。此外，我们使用知识图谱嵌入评分函数来建模药物与靶点之间的相互作用，具体而言，将DistMult和ComplEx作为解码器作用于学习到的节点表示之上。我们进行了广泛的（实验验证，摘要原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 本文提出MT-RGCN-DTI模型，通过整合药物-靶点相互作用网络、药物相似性网络和蛋白质相似性网络构建异构信息网络，并结合RGCN与DistMult、ComplEx知识图谱嵌入解码器，实现多任务药物-靶点相互作用预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MT-RGCN-DTI, a multi-task relational graph convolutional network that constructs a heterogeneous information network from drug-target interaction, drug-drug similarity, and protein-protein similarity networks, using DistMult and ComplEx knowledge graph embedding scoring functions as decoders for drug-target interaction prediction.
